name: retro-grid
title: Retro Grid
description: A synthwave-style perspective floor of thin grid lines that scroll toward the viewer and fade into a glow at the horizon, leaving space above for a headline.
use: A hero wants an eighties arcade or sci-fi floor behind its headline.
avoid: Calm corporate sites: the retro-sci-fi mood is very specific and loud.
a11y: Decorative and pointer-events-none; it freezes when the user prefers reduced motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark stage split by a flat horizon, with a perspective grid floor of thin grey lines fanning out to a vanishing point at the horizon. A bright magenta-to-purple headline floats above.
behaves: The floor scrolls toward the viewer on a slow fifteen-second loop, horizontal lines sliding down and outward while vertical lines fan from the horizon. It freezes when off-screen or when the user prefers reduced motion.
customise: Angle, cell size, opacity and separate light and dark line colours are props; scroll speed and perspective are fixed in the shader.
weight: heavy: A full-screen WebGL fragment shader redrawn every animation frame.
demo: The heading reads "Retro Grid" in a pink-purple gradient.
polishWhy: Crisp perspective grid with a convincing sense of depth; the scene is sparse by design.
